subsystems.name: UI perception
subsystems.role: turn the state of an app into a machine-readable description

subsystems.name: Action model
subsystems.role: decide the next action to take given a goal and the current state

subsystems.name: Planner
subsystems.role: break a high-level goal into steps and adapt when things go wrong

subsystems.name: Memory
subsystems.role: remember what has happened and what the user prefers

subsystems.name: Execution engine
subsystems.role: carry out clicks, keystrokes and API calls in the target environment

subsystems.name: Safety layer
subsystems.role: prevent harmful actions and keep the user in control

buildSteps.title: Collect interaction data
buildSteps.detail: Record humans performing tasks across many apps, capturing screenshots, UI element trees and the actions they take.

buildSteps.title: Label and align
buildSteps.detail: Pair each screen state with the goal and the correct next action, creating supervised training examples.

buildSteps.title: Train the action model
buildSteps.detail: Fine-tune a vision-language model to predict actions from the current screen and the goal.

buildSteps.title: Add planning
buildSteps.detail: Wrap the model in a reasoning loop that decomposes tasks and retries after failures.

buildSteps.title: Build the runtime
buildSteps.detail: Integrate browser control, OS input and API clients into a sandboxed execution environment.

buildSteps.title: Insert guardrails
buildSteps.detail: Define allowed action types, require confirmation for irreversible steps and log every action.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate and harden
buildSteps.detail: Test on benchmark suites of web and desktop tasks, then collect real-user feedback to retrain.

prerequisites.why: provide the language understanding and reasoning needed to follow goals and instructions.
let the agent interpret screenshots and identify buttons, fields and text.
give a reliable way to observe and control applications.
contain the agent so mistakes cannot damage the host system.
needed to measure reliability across diverse tasks, but current suites are limited.

pathway.milestone: narrow assistants that automate single apps or workflows
pathway.unlocks: productivity gains in well-defined tasks like form filling or data entry.

pathway.milestone: general web agents that can operate many sites with human supervision
pathway.unlocks: automation of multi-step online errands like booking and purchasing.

pathway.milestone: agents that learn from demonstration and chain apps together
pathway.unlocks: end-to-end business processes without custom integration.

pathway.milestone: autonomous agents with robust safety and audit
pathway.unlocks: delegation of complex digital work at scale, with humans overseeing exceptions.
